_comment: Licence server shipped with the app. url is the Supabase project. anonKey stays empty in git. npm run dist and npm run dist:mac write the publishable key from CC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY or SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, then clear it again. It is not the service key. An empty anonKey means every installed copy stays on the Free tier and EVERBORN-OWNER cannot redeem.
